This is a synthetic power system network model that covers the geographic
footprint of three midwest states (Michigan, Ohio and Indiana). The case is
designed with a 765, 345, 138 and 69 kV transmission network to serve a
load that roughly mimics the actual population of its geographic footprint.
The synthetic transmission system was designed by algorithms described in
[1] to be statistically similar to actual transmission system models but

program as part of the EPIGRIDS project.
